title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at Noelle’s Most Powerful Form
content: Black Clover Season 2 is gearing up for the fight against the next member of the Dark Triad, and the first look at the anime’s next episode is showing off Noelle Silva’s most powerful form.

title: Voice Actor Ryūji Nakagi Dies at 89
content: There was a private funeral for close relatives. Nakagi was born on October 24, 1936 in Tokyo. Nakagi's roles included Gōzō Yūtenji in Yawara! title: Comic CMOA Partially Resumes Service
content: NTT Solmare announced on Thursday that its Comic CMOA manga service has partially resumed service, after it suspended service for maintenance for almost two weeks due to an unauthorized external access.
author: ANN

title: AI no Idenshi's Kyūri Yamada Launches New Manga
content: Kodansha 's Comic Days platform announced on Sunday Kyūri Yamada will launch a new manga titled Nanabun no Survivor ( The One-Seventh Survivor ) on Monday. The series will also serialize on Kodansha 's YanMaga Web platform beginning November 16.
author: ANN

title: Toshimichi Uzō Launches New Manga
content: Shogakukan 's Manga ONE platform announced on Friday writer Toshimichi Uzō will launch a new manga with artist Yuitsu titled Yome wo Dungeon de Koroshitai (I Want to Kill My Bride in a Dungeon) on the platform on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: The Bloodthirsty Bride Devours the King Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: A website opened on Monday to announce that a television anime of writer Shiki and artist Yū Shinonome's The Bloodthirsty Bride Devours the King (Chi ni Ueta Hanayome wa Ō o Kurau) manga will air next year. The "forbidden dark romantic fantasy" is set in an era of war.
author: ANN

title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Earns US$400 Million Globally
content: According to Box Office Mojo, the film has earned US$399,998,502 globally: US$157,398,502 in the United States and US$242,600,000 internationally. The film ranked at #7 in the U.S. last weekend, earning an estimated US$2,525,000 from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Voltage, Toei Animation Reveal Kakan Ruirui: The Caged Lantern of Yomi Otome Game For Release in 2027 on Switch
content: Game developer Voltage announced on Monday it and Toei Animation are developing the Kakan Ruirui: The Caged Lantern of Yomi (Kakan Ruirui: Urayomi Terasu Hōzukiyo) otome game for a scheduled digital release on Nintendo Switch in 2027. Voltage is releasing the game as part of its console brand AmuLit.
author: ANN

title: Toshihiro Nagoshi's Nagoshi Studio Shuts Down
content: NetEase Games had announced the formation of Nagoshi Studio Inc. in January 2022. The studio announced its first game Gang of Dragon during The Game Awards in December 2025. Bloomberg then reported in March 2026 that a NetEase spokesperson confirmed it will stop financing the studio.
author: ANN
